bio: Brorg doesn't say much, but his actions speak volumes. In battle he finds his peace, and in his companions, his true home.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.effect: While it lasts: advantage on Strength checks, +2 to melee damage, and resistance to physical blows. He can't cast magic.

abilities.name: Unarmored Defense
abilities.effect: His armor already accounts for his natural toughness: heavy armor doesn't improve it.

goal: Find a place (or a people) to belong to.
